findings.title: Indemnity carved out of aggregate liability cap
findings.deviation: Clause 7.1 carves out all indemnification obligations from the aggregate liability cap, exposing AtliQ to unlimited liability.
findings.impact: AtliQ risks unlimited financial exposure for indemnification claims under the agreement.
findings.quote: Neither party liable for consequential damages. Each party's aggregate liability capped at fees paid or payable under the applicable SOW, except for confidentiality breaches and indemnity.
findings.counterPosition: Limit liability cap carve-outs to confidentiality breaches, fraud, willful misconduct, and IP infringement indemnification.

findings.title: Most Favored Customer rate requirement
findings.deviation: Clause 9.1 requires AtliQ to guarantee that rates are its lowest in the US and automatically extend lower rates if offered to any other customer.
findings.impact: AtliQ could be forced to lower its contract pricing if it offers lower rates to any other US client during the 36-month term.
findings.quote: Consultant warrants that the rates in Exhibit A are no less favorable than those Consultant charges any other customer in the United States for comparable services. If Consultant offers lower rates to another U.S. customer during the Term, Consultant shall extend them to Cobalt.
findings.counterPosition: Delete Section 9.1 (Most Favored Customer clause) in its entirety.

findings.title: Liquidated damages clause lacks sole remedy language
findings.deviation: Clause 10.1 sets the correct LD rate, cap, and client-delay exclusion, but omits specifying that LDs are AtliQ's sole and exclusive remedy for delay.
findings.impact: Cobalt could potentially seek additional damages for delay beyond the agreed liquidated damages.
findings.quote: Liquidated damages of 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week of Consultant-caused delay, capped at 5% of that milestone fee.
findings.counterPosition: Add explicit language stating that liquidated damages are Cobalt's sole and exclusive remedy for delay.

findings.title: Professional liability insurance limit requires verification
findings.deviation: Clause 11.2 requires AtliQ to maintain $1,000,000 in professional liability insurance.
findings.impact: AtliQ must verify that its existing insurance policy covers $1,000,000 in professional liability.
findings.quote: Consultant shall maintain professional liability insurance of $1,000,000.
findings.counterPosition: Confirm AtliQ's current professional liability policy meets the $1,000,000 limit or adjust the contractual requirement to match existing coverage.

fine.note: Net 30 days payment terms comply with AtliQ standard.
Termination for convenience provides 30 days' notice and payment for work performed.
Confidentiality provisions are mutual with a standard 3-year duration.
Deliverables transfer upon payment and AtliQ retains background IP with a non-exclusive licence.
60-day warranty for SOW conformity is standard.
Offshore processing in India is allowed provided customer personal data is not stored outside the US.
Mutual indemnity structure for IP, confidentiality, and gross negligence/willful misconduct is acceptable.
